captions.detailed: A tall, red candy vending machine featuring three vertically stacked rectangular glass bins, each with a corresponding rotary selector dial below it. Below the bottom-most dial is a single rectangular retrieval door. The three silver selector dials are designed to rotate continuously on parallel horizontal shafts, while the silver retrieval door at the bottom rotates downward on a horizontal hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a triple-dial candy vending machine. The model should have a tall red body housing three stacked glass display windows, three rotating silver selector dials positioned below each window, and a single silver retrieval door at the bottom that swings downward.
captions.factory: The code constructs a main base body using a tall box primitive colored red, with inset grey box visuals representing three display windows and a retrieval door. Three separate dial parts are modeled as cylinders with small rectangular handles on their faces, positioned vertically down the front of the body. A bottom retrieval door is defined as an additional part, and the assembly is completed by defining continuous rotational joints for the three dials (rotating around the Y-axis) and a revolute joint for the bottom door (rotating around the X-axis).
